title: Cubic Shenanigans
description: Welcome to Cubic Shenanigans! A modpack created for a Vanilla+ SMP experience!
body:
## Overview Welcome to Cubic Shenanigans!
This modpack provides a Vanilla+ Minecraft Experience geared towards long-term servers. At it's core it implements many server-side quality of life features while trying to maintain the core gameplay of Vanilla Minecraft. Cubic Shenanigans aims to avoid client-side QOL to allow for easy customization for users. The modpack also implements proximity chat to make large servers more enjoyable and approachable! Sprinkled on top are some optimization mods to ensure everything runs smooth! Cubic Shenanigans will gain (and lose) mods, trying to keep the base modpack functional with the most recent version of Minecraft. Below you can find a list of mods included with the current version.
Included Mods [!] -> Mod is disabled on download - [Architectury](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) - [Armor Poser](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-poser) - [Armor Statues](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-statues/versions) - [Audio Player](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer/versions) - [Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements/versions) - [!] Carpet - [Chiseled Bookshelf Visualizer](https://modrinth.com/mod/chiseled-bookshelf-visualizer?version=1.21.8&loader=fabric) - [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [Clumps](https://modrinth.com/mod/clumps) - [Coord Finder](https://modrinth.com/mod/coord-finder) - [Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders) - [Datapack Injector](https://modrinth.com/mod/datapack-injector) - [!] Elytra Rework : Custom mod created for this modpack. Disabled... stay tuned for official Modrinth page. - [Elytra Trim](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-trims) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Fabric Language Kotlin API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) - [Ferrite Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - [Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port) - [Inhabitor](https://modrinth.com/mod/inhabitor) - [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - [Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) - [!] Krypton - [Ledger](https://modrinth.com/mod/ledger) - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - [Peek](https://modrinth.com/mod/peek) - [Puzzles Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzles-lib) - [!] SHA1 Runtime Hash Updater - [!] Simple Discord Rich Presence - [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat/versions) - [Simple Voice Chat: Enhanced Groups](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhanced-groups) - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium/versions) - [Sodium: Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) - [Spark](https://modrinth.com/mod/spark) - [Status](https://modrinth.com/mod/status) - [Status View Distance Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/view-distance-fix) - [WorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
